title: Published Figures for Payoff Quotes, Waiver Coverage and Title Release on Auto Loans
content:
Three areas of the Auto Loans line carry published figures of their own: the quotation of a payoff, the guaranteed asset protection waiver coverage that may be financed with the loan, and the release of the bank's lien once the loan closes.

| Figure | Used Vehicle Loan | Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | Auto Refinance Loan | Lease Buyout Loan | New Vehicle Loan | Green Vehicle Loan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days a payoff quote remains good | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Waiver coverage may be purchased with this loan | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| One-time waiver charge financed at funding, USD | 695.00 | 695.00 | 595.00 | 595.00 | 795.00 | 795.00 |
| Full-refund window on that charge, in calendar days after funding | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Cancellation fee published for that charge, USD | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| How a refund of that charge is prorated | by the remaining term | by the remaining term | by the remaining term | by the remaining term | by the remaining term | by the remaining term |
| Business days after payoff by which the lien release is sent | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Where the products part company

Only the waiver charge differs across the Auto Loans line, and it differs in three steps: 595.00 USD on the Auto Refinance Loan and the Lease Buyout Loan, 695.00 USD on the Used Vehicle Loan and the Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan, and 795.00 USD on the New Vehicle Loan and the Green Vehicle Loan. The charge is financed with the loan at funding, so it forms part of the amount financed rather than being billed separately.

## Two figures that read alike and mean differently

The first row and the last row of the table both read 10, and both are periods, but they are not counted the same way. The days a payoff quote remains good are calendar days. The days within which the lien release is sent are business days.
